objective: Test a directly observable rank signal: when the opponent threatens a chain, does the subject's choice to extend depend on the long-range result of a hypothetical ladder, beyond local shape and the existing R1 rank posterior?
inputs: All validation questions of R1 folds 1–4 (5/10/20 games), joined to the stored SQ4 rank fusion posterior in m183_dump.npz. Folds 1/2 fit the correction; fold 3 and fold 4 are untouched by this correction and are assessed separately and together. Historical R1 development has used these folds. No fold 0, official questions, leaderboard feedback, or identity verifier.
opportunity: From the exact 19x19 SGF before the subject's response, identify an own chain with two liberties immediately before the opponent's last move, then exactly one afterward. Use positions with exactly one such threatened chain, no ko ban, and a legal noncapturing extension at the last liberty that leaves exactly two liberties. The response is whether the subject actually plays that extension. Suppress consecutive extensions of the same chased chain until the chase is interrupted. Passes are legitimate choices. Use all chain sizes, separating singleton and larger chains.
counterfactual: After the hypothetical extension ask KataGo Board::searchIsLadderCapturedAttackerFirst2Libs for a capturing continuation on the actual board, and again with only stones in a 7x7 window centered on the extension (the original board edges remain). Require the post-extension chain to have the same size and two liberties in both views. A safe flag means the restricted ladder search found no capture. Do not infer a game-theoretically best move, a ladder breaker of a particular color, or general life and death.
controls: Per question and each of four cells (7x7 ladder verdict times own chain size 1/2+), record the number of opportunities, number of noncaptured full-board continuations F, extensions played A, and joint count J. The marginal model receives event frequency, favorable-position frequency and response frequency in each cell. The full model additionally gets the pooled within-cell slope sum(J - F*A/N) / (4 + sum(F - F^2/N)). Null: draw J from a hypergeometric distribution preserving each individual question-cell's exact N,F,A; one fixed feature seed 20261118. The base is the frozen SQ4 decision. A control with the full-board opportunity frequencies alone also helps interpret whether the signal lies in positions encountered or in choices.
model: Ten-class exponential tilt of the frozen pooled posterior along ordinal rank with a ridge penalty of 0.05 times squared coefficients. The input features are residualized against intercept, baseline expected grade, its square and log game count on development data, standardized and clipped at +/-4 using development values. Fit once on folds 1/2 (equal total weight for each size and grade cell), without feature selection. Reapply the original SQ4 guard2 with its ct106 reference to every decision. Include the six-member base as a secondary comparison only if warranted; judgments are on SQ4.
decision: Primary is equal-grade and equal-size competition score (exact 1, neighbor exp(-1), else 0) on pooled folds 3/4. Advance the response signal only if full-minus-marginal and full-minus-SQ4 are both positive with paired two-sided 95% player-cluster lower bounds above 0, full-minus-SQ4 >= 0.001, and full-minus-SQ4 positive in both folds. Report negative control, NLL, scores by size, numbers improved/worsened, and information/coverage. If signal fails, do not tune on these test folds.
integrity: Use the repository parser to restore handicaps and colors. Drop whole games with illegal or unparseable move sequences and whole questions containing such games. Exclude identical raw SGFs shared across development/evaluation folds. Assert exact input baseline/labels/sizes/owner row alignment, zero-feature reproduction of saved SQ4 and agreement of stored SQ4 decisions with the latest M221 reference. Sampling unit for uncertainty is a player, with all overlapping 5/10/20-game questions together. Store compressed counts only.
